name: dev.mnemodb/mnemodb
description: Persistent agent memory as plain Markdown in your repo - readable, diffable, with provenance.

environmentVariables.name: MNEMO_STORE
environmentVariables.description: Directory containing the .memory/ store. If unset, the server uses CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR (set by Claude Code), then the working directory. An empty value is an error: the server refuses rather than writing the store somewhere that will not persist.
